resharper_simple_case_statement_style #

Whether a simple case statement is put on one line. ⚠ Probed rather than reasoned about: eleven fixtures under this repository's own .editorconfig, one cleanupcode invocation per configuration, each fixture first shown to move under the key that really governs its construct. Inert at all three values, at 120 and at 60 columns, and with keep_existing_embedded_arrangement = false in the same run — byte-identical to that run without this key. csharp_place_simple_case_statement_on_same_line is what governs the shape under this export.

Typeone of do_not_change, on_single_line, line_break

resharper_treat_case_statement_with_break_as_simple #

Undocumented ReSharper property; classified as C#-relevant by vocabulary. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unresolved. Flat at both values on two switch fixtures — one whose sections all end in break, one mixing return sections with a break section — under resharper_place_simple_case_statement_on_same_line at if_owner_is_single_line, always and never. ⚠ But no positive control exists: that key, the one this key modifies, is itself flat in the oracle on both fixtures (SPURIOUS — Skala joins the section, the oracle does not).
